description:
“Can’t you give me what I said I wanted as compensation earlier?”    
“What did you want?”    
“Han Hee-joo.”    
To avoid an unwanted arranged meeting, she asked a colleague to be her substitute fiancé. But the one who showed up was Kang Tae-jun, Hee-joo's long-time crush. In her fantasies, she’d done all sorts of things with him, but now that he’s actually sitting next to her, even a single glance makes her tingle and tremble. A thrilling and precarious day with the lover from her fantasies, aided by fate, begins.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13925303), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5285002317)
